title: Quiet window 1: baseline-bin vs devoff1-bin, both at defaults. Title/attract loop, no input needed
notes: Do not touch the PC while it runs. Both arms sit on the title/attract loop, which the game reaches with no input.

Per Agent 3: the window starts a fixed 60 s after the first guest frame and is 60 s long, with 5 runs per arm alternating. Round-robin with a rotating start gives A B B A A B B A A B. Compare medians and p99, not means (the attract loop alternates between ~25 and ~52 fps phases).
One unscored cold run per bin comes first, because the first boot of a bin pays one-off costs.

The runner always passes --audio_mute=true --pause_when_unfocused=false --native_settings_load=false --discord_rpc=false. The toml keeps framerate_limit = 60, so a CPU-side win can show as lower cpu_cores and fewer >33/>100 ms frames rather than as a lower median.
